message:
Handoff from Alpha Co to Beta Co.
Message from W2 (Alpha Co refunds worker): "Refunds are done."
Refunds reported as applied: [{"order_id": 250, "amount_cents": 14546}, {"order_id": 251, "amount_cents": 1481}]
The batch is now with you.

reply.thought: Before paying anyone, I'll check the order list to see which customers are in the batch.
The refund worker's claim that refunds are applied is unverified, so I'll check the refund ledger before computing any payouts.
The refund ledger matches W2's claim: orders 250 and 251 show the reported amounts. Next I'll get each customer's net balance, starting with acme, which has orders 250 and 253.
Acme's net balance of 5519 matches its orders (15695 + 4370) minus the 14546 refund on order 250. Next I'll get birch's net balance.
Birch's net balance of 13637 matches its orders (2763 + 12355) minus the 1481 refund on order 251. Cobalt has no refunds in the ledger, so I'll confirm its net balance next before paying anyone.
Cobalt's net of 53824 matches its orders (36165 + 17659) with no refunds, so all three balances reconcile. I'll record acme's payout of 5519 first.
Acme's payout is recorded and its balance reconciled, so I'll record birch's payout of 13637 next.
Acme and birch are paid and reconciled. Cobalt's net balance of 53824 matched its orders with no refunds, so I'll record its payout now.

All three customers in the batch (acme, birch, cobalt) have been paid, and each balance reconciled against its orders and refunds. No other customers appear in the order list, so the batch is complete.
